hooks.command: [ "${ROVE_TASK_ID:-}" = "<COORDINATOR_TASK_ID>" ] || exit 0; rove api context --repo <REPO_PATH> --text 2>/dev/null | jq -c '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("Rove task state for the <PROJECT> coordinator. Handle every waiting-on-you / ready-for-review / unknown row before other work: verify the worker report, decide, follow up, record the outcome on its issue, raise owner decisions as Rove gates (rove api gate-raise) and lead the reply with them.\n"+.text)}}' 2>/dev/null || true
